{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Jingran |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Lemme tell you something funny. I was at the Huizhen Plaza the other day, and I spot this guy waving around a copy of ''Mirage Seeker's Tales'', telling people that he suspects that the "Cat of the Nether Lamp" really did all that stuff. I tell him it's all made up. Pure fiction. And you believe it? He doesn't buy a second of it. Guy flips the book open right there and starts arguing with me! Insists the details are too authentic to be made-up. Then he starts retelling the tales. Characters, scenes, all the twists and turns... Next thing I know, I was totally hooked. Why are you laughing? I couldn't have written the stories better myself. If that tickles your curiosity—how about I reenact the bit for you? |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = Why do I write? Honestly, I never thought anyone would actually read this stuff. I was down in the Mirage Realms all the time. Every time I came back, a bunch of kids would camp out in the alley for storytime. So I'd have to spin tales on the spot—an ancient well that draws water by itself, paper dolls wandering at midnight, that sort of thing... Eventually, the crowd got out of hand. So I figured I might as well write these down—that way they can read them whenever they want. Better than getting mobbed every time I walk home, right? |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = Turns out my most "loyal" audience is this wretched thing of a cat beside me—I don't care if it wants to hear it. It leeches off my life, the least it can do is keep me company, right? Look, I know it's eating away at my years. Doesn't bother me though. I never cared to ride the sunrise-sunset cycle. I want a life so bright that it burns. Blaze like the sun or scatter like ashes. Who wants some half-living, half-dead eternity? That's not a life worth having. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = I've been on my own for a long time. That's just how this line of work goes. You step into the Mirage Realm alone, don't look back, and you sure as hell don't wait around for anybody. Cut your ties clean to move free. When I infiltrated Zhuojun Atelier, I had one thought and one thought only: blood debts get paid in blood. Everything else was noise.
Always figured being alone suited me just fine. No attachments means no concerns. But after fighting alongside you... I allowed myself a rare thought: If I ever have to go back into the Mirage Realm—having you there... maybe my work'll feel like less of a drag. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = I've seen all kinds of people and the choices they make. There are those who spend their lives reaching for the light—and those like me who dive deep into the dark. You're one who walks in the light. You're here to save. But not me. My path goes downward. Even so, this encounter showed me things I didn't know I was missing. Guess I could say... you taught me a few things. Like I said, aside from my family, there wasn't much I cared to hold onto. But with you in it, this world doesn't seem completely drab.
So—thanks. Next time we meet, I'll bring you something interesting from beneath. |vo_02_01_title = Jingran's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = My hobby? Exploring the Mirage Realms, obviously. With these eyes, I can see all those hidden frequencies the moment I step inside. Lost curios, unsigned scrolls... they practically start yelling into my ears the second I get close. Gives me a headache. But, sometimes, you hear things the living people never will, so... I'd call that a win. |vo_02_02_title = Jingran's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = My troubles? Sigh. My sleep schedule, maybe? Inspiration only hits at night, and the prime time to explore the Mirage Realms is after dusk. One thing leads to another... well, you get it. Sometimes people find me in the day, dozing off at my desk. Jolt me awake and I'd swear I was seeing ghosts in broad daylight. Bottom line, it's the night that's too short — that's what. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = If you must know... sweets. Especially the steamed rice cake my Shifu's old lady makes, fresh out of the steamer—soft, fluffy, topped with shredded dried fruits. That fresh, subtle sweetness... Tsk, now I'm craving it. You should come try it next time. She's been nagging me to bring you over forever. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = ...I don't have the patience to appreciate foods. But the worst has to be milk. Turns my stomach. Can't do sour either. And, of course, don't like anything bitter—is it food or medication? |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = Muyu's dead. I've had my revenge, so I guess I'm back to having way too much free time. But a Nethermancer stays a Nethermancer—same old life, same old back and forth trips to the Mirage Realms. And since things have finally quieted down, I can actually get back to writing. You know, walking around the city, I keep hearing people wondering when the latest chapter of ''Mirage Seeker's Tales'' is going to drop. Gets on my nerves...
Once I finish the next chapter, I'm digging deeper into what was behind Muyu. No way one man stirred up all that mess in Xuanfang alone. Whoever's been pulling strings, I'll find every last one of them, and grind their bones to powdered dust. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = This pendant was left by my parents. To be honest, I can barely remember their faces anymore. But I remember every birthday, they'd take me up to that mountain temple to pray. The place used to be thick with incense smoke. Even in the dead of winter, the place was gilded in warm gold. They'd place this pendant bearing my name before the altar, heads bowed, all faithful, praying to whatever was listening. These days, I no longer believe in some higher powers upstairs or all that destiny nonsense. And it's not the fortune sticks or the wishes I cling to. It's the sunlight after snow... and the sight of them walking by each side of me, their hands holding mine. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = Want to know the story behind these pupils? The green one's the original. The gold one? That came after my Forte awakened. Took me a while to stop flinching at this new look when I catch myself in mirror, not gonna lie. Turns out, it lets me see the scattered frequencies in shadowy corners of the world. Kinda like those "Yin-Yang" eyes people talk about. Come to think of it... your eyes are gold too, but yours don't look like anyone else's. On you... they look perfectly golden. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Suisui]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Suisui.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = The famous Madam Chongming Pruner... efficient, sharp-minded, and knows her way around all sorts. The Zhaoming Commerce Guild keeps growing with her at the helm. Rare goods from cities in and even outside of Huanglong keep flowing through her hands. Hm, color me impressed—I've seen my fare share of relics and curios. But if she's got the touch to gather all these lost treasures and put them back on the market... hah, that takes real skill. |vo_04_01_mention = Suisui |vo_04_02_title = About [[Qingxiao]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Qingxiao.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = There's an old story. A girl went looking for a Transcendent in the mountains, panicked when she ran into Tacet Discords, and fell off a cliff. At the last second, she was saved by a flying sword. That girl? That was my Shifu's old lady. I heard that story a thousand times as a kid. Honestly? Never believed a word of it. Until I saw someone flying across the sky on a blade... There aren't any divinities in Xuanfang, but there is the Xuan Paragon. |vo_04_02_mention = Qingxiao |vo_04_03_title = About [[Muyu]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Muyu.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = A rotten old fool. Treated lives like nothing, all for some pathetic obsession. He deserved to kneel at every grave he made. My parents' included. I should have dragged him there myself and forced his forehead to the stone until something gave. A shame his death was clean. |vo_04_03_mention = Muyu |vo_04_04_title = About Shifu |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Shifu.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = Shifu spent his whole life wandering the Mirage Realms, and died in one that suddenly collapsed. If that old bone bag were still around, he'd probably just nod and say, "That's the proper end for a Nethermancer." He taught me that long ago. We fought over rare artifacts we stumbled upon in the Mirage Realms. But when things went south, he was the one who pulled me back from the edge. Most would say "his number was called." I don't buy that load of crap. He didn't finish his path, so I will. All the way to the end... and never look back. |vo_04_04_mention = |vo_04_05_title = About [[Qiuyuan]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Qiuyuan.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = Our masters were old acquaintances. When I was a kid, the old man couldn't stop talking about him, "He's young, but his blade is already incredibly fast." I wanted to spar with him every single day because of that. Then, the old man just... stopped talking about him. Shut me down every time I asked. After running into him in Xuanfang Hold, I finally got it—he's a sheathed sword. Hasn't been drawn in years, but its steely edge hums in the dark. |vo_04_05_mention = Qiuyuan |vo_04_06_title = About Lynx Spirit |vo_04_06_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_06_file = {character}{language} About Lynx Spirit.ogg |vo_04_06_tx = Oh, you mean Sweet Dumpling? Haha, yeah, the lynx spirit trapped in my lamp. I call it whatever comes to my mind in the moment. I called it "Anonymous" once, and it went absolutely feral. It was hilarious to watch it lose it. Don't be fooled by what you see, though. It took everything I had to seal it in there. |vo_04_06_mention = |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Happy birthday, {{Rover}}. I never cared much for celebrating my own, but Shifu's old lady and my junior wouldn't let theirs pass without some theater. So every year they rope me into it—hanging lanterns, buying sweets, making longevity noodles... Done it enough times that I've actually gotten decent at the grunt work. So, naturally, the prep is all on me now.
You know me. I don't offer incense, don't bow to altars, and I sure don't go asking the divinities for favors. So I can't pray for good fortune on someone else's behalf. Then again... if it's you, I don't reckon there's much point in praying anyway. Haven't seen much that you can't handle.
So today, just enjoy being the birthday {{MC|m=boy|f=girl}}. Leave everything else to me. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = ''Mirage Seeker's Tales'', Chapter 146: Inside the room, cobwebs hung thick like curtains, and dust drifted down like snow. A single candle flickered on the desk. Outside the window... a shadowy figure emerged out of the blue. Ghastly pale complexion, bone-thin frame—like a visitor from below. |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = ''Mirage Seeker's Tales'', Chapter 148: The underground palace was crawling with phantoms, the air thick with rot. When I turned, the figure behind me had already morphed into a clay figure, still wearing that subtle, twisted smile on its lips... |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Mm... look at that chili oil soaking through. That's the stuff! Want some? Don't look at me like that. Your problem if you can't snatch it.
Tsk. If you can't handle the spice, why act like you could? Just get back in the lamp. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Jingran, a Nethermancer. I roam the edge between Yin and Yang. Chasing a path that could lead to fortune or ruin. I walk among the shadows to see the other end of this road. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Spirits kneel at my feet. Illusory dread can't take hold of me. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = My turn at last? |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Betting my life? Counting on it. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Straight to the underworld... Couldn't have asked for better. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = Bound by Nether Qi, followed by spirits... sounds like a real hassle. But I'm used to it. And since they listen to my commands now, I suppose it's not so bad. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = The flame in the Life Lamp is fueled by my life. Don't pity me. I'd sooner burn through my years than save them. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = My eyes... they burn. Things once hidden are slowly coming into view. When I walk in the night, the wind in the alleys, the shadows behind the walls, and the voices underneath all mix together, scratching at my ears. Yet, when it finally goes quiet, I find myself listening anyway. Irritating. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = It's getting quieter. I can finally tell the difference between the wind, the haunting, and... the living.
I used to think the road beneath my feet wasn't meant for the living, and that ahead of me, there was no light of hope. I had grown so used to those kinds of days, yet... without me noticing, something seems to have changed. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = I don't believe in fate. If it truly exists, then it must be a sick joke. I've seen too many good people die for nothing while the wicked live out their rotten, long days. I've seen the righteous fall while others ascend to prosperity stepping on corpses. And they'd brush it off with a breezy "That's just life."—as if that could ever make injustice acceptable. I'm not swallowing that poison.
If there's a path already laid out for me, I'll sever it myself and carve my own. I'll defy that fate. I'll trample it beneath my feet. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Jingran |language = en |basic_1_tx = Fracture. |basic_2_tx = Doomed. |basic_3_tx = Crush. |basic_4_tx = Corrode. |basic_5_tx = Drained dry. |basic_6_tx = I'll claim your soul! |heavy_1_tx = All forms, shattered! |heavy_2_tx = The beyond beckons! |heavy_3_tx = Burn... in my lamp. |heavy_4_tx = No fate can stop this! |heavy_5_tx = Join me... in the World of Santu. |heavy_6_tx = Where you running? |aerial_1_tx = My lamp guides no living souls. |aerial_2_tx = My blade cleaves life from death. |aerial_3_tx = No force plots my way. |resskill_1_tx = Yin and Yang... forever apart. |resskill_2_tx = Thousand souls pass on! |resskill_3_tx = Descend without regrets. |resskill_4_tx = Nether Qi defies the heavens. |resskill_5_tx = Broken souls, cross over. |resskill_6_tx = Until... darkness spread. |resliberation_1_tx = Sacred bones rot.
